payload.reason: The evidence provides sufficient information on how lexicons are compared, particularly through crowd evaluations versus expert evaluations, and the quality of annotations in lexicon acquisition.

claims.text: Crowd evaluations of lexicons are compared to those of expert linguists to assess overall lexicon quality.
Lexicon acquisition involves both subjective and objective tasks, with crowd diversity impacting the evaluation process.
The quality of lexicon annotations can be improved through filtering and evaluation processes involving both crowds and experts.
